buildCommand: curl -fsSL https://storage.googleapis.com/flutter_infra_release/releases/stable/linux/flutter_linux_3.27.1-stable.tar.xz -o /tmp/flutter.tar.xz && tar xf /tmp/flutter.tar.xz -C /opt/ && rm /tmp/flutter.tar.xz && export PATH=$PATH:/opt/flutter/bin && /opt/flutter/bin/flutter build web --release --dart-define=API_BASE_URL=$API_BASE_URL
